The electrical characteristics which were compared and analyzed for each thermal treatment are junction leakage current and junction breakdown voltage and sub-threshold current- and latch-up immunity. We propose that RTA is superior to FA in thermal process from the viewpoint of electrical characteristics. We obtained excellent leakage currents and junction breakdown voltage characteristics by RTA process.

articleTitle: The speech enhancement of the G.723.1 vocoder using multi-order formant postfilter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: The speech quality of CELP type vocoders is improved by compensating the formant distortion with a formant postfilter. The formant postfilter is generally composed of the conventional ARMA filter with the 1-order tilt compensation filter. We propose a new method to improve speech quality using multi-order tilt compensation filter instead of the 1-order tilt compensation filter. This algorithm is applied to G.723.1 for Internet phone or videoconferencing. Consequently, spectrum distortion is improved about 3.22% and speech quality is improved about 0.04 of MOS score maximally.

articleTitle: Mathematical model and performance analysis of an improved hybrid code acquisition algorithm in DS-SS systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: We present a mathematical model and a performance analysis of an improved hybrid code acquisition algorithm, which applies the early rejection mode in conventional hybrid search method in direct sequence spread spectrum (DS-SS) systems. The mean code acquisition time is derived and analyzed for the acquisition algorithm. We also compare the mean code acquisition time of the improved hybrid search algorithm with those of conventional ones under IMT-2000 channel models. The result indicates that the mean code acquisition time of improved hybrid search algorithm is reduced by about 60% than those of conventional ones.

articleTitle: Design of trellis-coded GMSK modulation for AWGN channel
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper, a communication scheme based on Gaussian minimum shift keying (GMSK) signal with trellis-coded modulation is presented. The coded/modulation scheme is an attractive technique for transmission of digital information over a bandwidth and power-limited channel. The coding gain of trellis codes provides power efficiency, and GMSK provides bandwidth efficiency due to the constant-envelope properties and good spectral features like all the CPM signals. In the receiver we propose an optimum detection Viterbi algorithm. Optimal trellis codes for the scheme can be found with computer simulation.

articleTitle: Regularized image sequence interpolation by fusing low-resolution frames
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper presents the feasibility of using different data sets, which correspond to the same scene to get a better resolution and information of the scene than the one obtained using only one data set. We propose a regularized image sequence interpolation algorithm, which can restore high frequency details by fusing low-resolution frames. In order to apply the regularization approach to the interpolation procedure, we use a two-dimensional separable image degradation model for a low resolution imaging system. The proposed algorithm provides a better-interpolated image by fusing low-resolution frames.

articleTitle: Design of a 3rd order CMOS sigma-delta modulator with the faster conversion rates using zero-pole canceling technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper proposes a new SDM (Sigma delta modulator) architecture to improve conversion rates and SNR (Signal-to noise ratio). The characteristic of the proposed SDM employs an adaptive clocking architecture which includes the first integrator with a 1 MHz clock and the second/third integrator with a 4 MHz clock. The SDM circuit with a 0.65 um CMOS process is simulated by both MATLAB and HSPICE. The simulation results illustrate that SNRs of the proposed SDM are increased by 2 dB@internal 1 bit ADC/DAC and 7 dB@3 bit and 5 bit, compared with the conventional SDM.

articleTitle: Speech restoration from LPC parameters corrupted by channel noise
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Restoration of speech parameters that have been degraded by noisy channel is of paramount importance, since mutilated speech parameters such as linear predictive coefficients (LPC) may render speech totally irrecoverable. The paper provides a technique using discrete dyadic wavelet transforms as a preprocessing stage prior to LPC extraction. We show that this step makes the speech parameters more robust to noise perturbation in the channel and hence makes recovery of speech possible. We discuss the effects of applying a single level and a three level transformation to speech prior to compression and compare the quality of recovered speech in both cases. We also apply a Wiener filter to the wavelet coefficients and show that the recovered speech is of appreciable quality.

articleTitle: A study on traffic parameters estimation of call admission control in ATM networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Much effort has been being devoted to studying the ATM technology for supporting multiservice high-speed communication networks. Since ATM adopts the statistical multiplexing technique, call admission control (CAC) is one of the most important issues under discussion. Until now, many CAC algorithms have calculated the required bandwidth of the connection using the parameters of a general source model. However, in actual ATM networks, each subscriber needs to declare the traffic characteristic in the form of a determinant traffic descriptor such as PCR (peak cell rate), SCR (sustainable cell rate), and MBS (maximum burst size) during the call set-up phase. Therefore, such determinant traffic parameters are necessary to be calculated from the VBR source modeling in ATM networks. In this paper, we work on traffic parameters estimation from VBR source modeling in ATM networks. Through simulation, we determine the traffic parameters from the VBR source modeling, which satisfy the quality of service (QOS) requirements with the least cost. Our study lets us gain a deep insight into the traffic parameters when the source parameters and the buffer size are varied.

articleTitle: An implementation of VoIP cable modem
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Cable telecommunication technology allows high-speed bi-directional transfer of Internet protocol (IP) traffic, between the CATV headend system and customer locations, over all-coaxial or hybrid fiber-coax (HFC) cable network. With the rapid progress of VoIP (voice over IP) technology, IP telephony service via cable networks has become a preferred strategy for cable data service providers. This paper presents an implementation of VoIP cable modem, which is named DCM-100. Design issues, hardware architecture, software architecture, and performance testing results are described.

articleTitle: A low power optimal motion search algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: We propose an efficient algorithm using temporal correlation, which employs a lower computational complexity but without sacrificing the accuracy. To achieve this goal, two techniques are employed, one is recursive motion vector estimation, and the other is a hierarchical layer processing for different motion feature. With this approach, we can attain near-global optimization and local optimization. In the final evaluation, the proposed complexity is only 1/2/spl sim/1/5 of full search, but the accuracy is slightly higher than one of full search in the particular range.

articleTitle: A new parallel signaling algorithm for reducing switching activity in a LCD driving system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: We present a new coding algorithm that can reduce temporal bit transition activities for a LCD (Liquid Crystal Display) driving system. The proposed algorithm is a non-redundant coding scheme and can be easily implemented with simple XOR gates. We have simulated the proposed algorithm and compared the results of the proposed algorithm with those of other coding algorithms. The proposed algorithm can minimize the switching activity by max. 65% for pure text image.

articleTitle: A photonic ATM switch based on wavelength routing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: A photonic ATM switch has been actively studied for future telecommunication networks to transport various multimedia information. In this paper we propose a photonic ATM switch with a WDM cell buffer which also uses optical wavelength as the internal routing information of the switch. This paper also presents a large capacity photonic ATM switch architecture that is suitable for a switching node of wavelength-division multiplexing networks. The switch can provide very large ATM cell switching capacity, for instance 10 Tbit/s, with reasonable complexity.

articleTitle: Microbenchmarks of operating system performance on the multiprocessor platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: We evaluate the performance of three popular versions of the UNIX operating system on the Intel x86 multiprocessor (MP) architecture: Linux, UnixWare, Solaris. TclBench (Lai and Baker, 1996) is used to evaluate the performance of the operating systems on the Intel x86 MP system. The performance of primitive thread functions of each operating system is also measured to figure out the characteristics of each operating system on the MP environment.

articleTitle: The MIIS structure capacitor fabricated with high permittivity material
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: The MIIS (Metal Insulator Intrinsic Semiconductor) structure capacitor consists of the aluminum, ZnO insulator and n-type silicon doped with gold atoms. The different electrical characteristics of the devices from the standard MOIS (Metal Oxide Intrinsic Semiconductor) structure capacitor which is fabricated from SiO/sub 2/ are presented in this paper. The experimental results show that the threshold voltage of the devices (V/sub TO/) is smaller than the MOIS devices, the zinc oxide capacitor values (C/sub OX/) are higher but the total capacitor value (C/sub T/) of the device does not change.

articleTitle: Investigations on delta modulated inverter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Delta modulation offers a number of unique advantages in static PWM inverter applications in variable speed AC drives. The performance of a delta modulator is investigated in this paper for a square wave reference signal. This changeover from sine wave reference signal to square wave reference signal can reduce the cost of the control circuit significantly which is crucial in FHP drive range. The parametric sensitivity of this modulator is studied in this paper.

articleTitle: Performance of an adaptive fuzzy rule-based closed-loop power control in low earth orbit mobile satellite communication systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper we investigate the effect of an adaptive fuzzy closed-loop power control (CLPC) scheme on the performance of the DS/CDMA-based mobile satellite communication systems with a low earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation in which the long round trip delay (RTD) and fading effect according to elevation angle should be considered. Since the RTD between mobile terminals (MT) and earth station (ES) via satellite in LEO is on the order of 10-20 ns and fading is more severe, a conventional closed-loop power control with fixed step size is much less effective than it is on a terrestrial channel. In order to cope with this performance degradation, we propose a closed-loop power control scheme by adaptive fuzzy rule-based step size decision method which is based on fuzzy logic control (FLC). So, in this paper, we compare the performance of the adaptive fuzzy closed-loop power control with that of the conventional fixed step closed-loop power control, we show that the proposed method makes better performance.

articleTitle: Morphological filtering of multi-level image using entropy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper presents new properties of the discrete morphological skeleton representation of binary images, for lossless binary image compression, that is based on these properties. We proposed a morphological recognition algorithm using threshold linear superposition theory to analyze the distribution of randomly spaced and oriented blob shaped particles. We recognized the size and position of randomly shaped particles by using the hit/miss transform. We also illustrate the improvement mathematical morphology makes on the entropy thresholding of small targets.

articleTitle: Voxelization chip design using FPGAs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper, a set of projective algorithms for computationally fast and efficient functions for volume rendering are explored for hardware implementation. Three voxelization algorithms are used to model three-dimensional objects of a line, a triangle and a tetrahedron respectively. These codes are later compiled, simulated and downloaded (in bit streams) to the FPGA chip on the Altera hardware card. The overall architecture is shown. The main focus of this paper will be the implementation and analysis efforts in designing the FPGA based solution for voxelization.

articleTitle: Systolic array based on fast modular multiplication algorithm for RSA cryptosystem
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: A new modular multiplication algorithm is first proposed for increasing the computation speed of addition operations and then a bit-level systolic array architecture is designed for the RSA public key cryptosystem on the basis of the algorithm. The proposed systolic array architecture has distinctive features that not only computation speed is significantly fast but also hardware overhead is drastically decreased.

articleTitle: A study on the ternary DCG circuit design with matrix equation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Multiple-valued logic theory and the locally computable combinational circuit realization technique in making VLSI chips have become a very important subject of study. These fields are being actively researched in order to overcome the limitations and the problems in the existing method of binary digital logic circuit realizations. These fields also have the prospect of increasing the processing speed as well as the amount of information that can be stored in the same circuit area. In this paper the algorithm for designing highly parallel multiple-valued logic circuit on the basis of the heretofore mentioned methods with improvements using the matrix equation about cyclic characteristic nodes is discussed. Some examples are shown to demonstrate the usefulness of the proposed method in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and realization of ultrasonic wave Doppler instrument for vascular diagnostic based on digital signal processor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Blood vein disease is one of the diseases that can cause death. An early check up on the blood vein is expected to reduce the mortality index. One method of non-invasive checking that is still being developed is a diagnostic technique using ultrasonic Doppler waves. The instrument that is designed and realized in this research is based on the digital signal processor 56002, that can help the doctor in analyzing abnormality of the patient blood vein. The instrument uses double ultrasonic transducers that work at a frequency of 3.5 MHz. The transducer output is processed by an analog and digital system to obtain the Doppler spectrum and Doppler sonogram. These graphical data are then processed by computer to obtain functional information about the blood vein condition. The instrument can measure flow velocity from 1 mm/s to 100 cm/s, with power intensity 13.4 mW/cm/sup 2/, with an allowed exposure time not exceeding 3731 seconds. The results obtained are checked from Doppler sound at the loudspeaker, direction and magnitude of blood flow velocity at the liquid crystal display and sonogram graphic at the computer monitor. This instrument has been realized by fulfilling safety criteria from AIUM; it can be used for diagnostics of several abnormalities of the human blood vein.

articleTitle: A new machine learning algorithm: fixed partition averaging
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: We propose the Fixed Partition Averaging (FPA) method for reducing the storage requirement and classification time of memory based reasoning (MBR). This method extracts representative patterns from the training set using an instance averaging technique. First, the proposed algorithm partitions the pattern space into a fixed number of hyperrectangles, and then it averages patterns in each hyperrectangle to extract a representative. This algorithm then uses the mutual information between the features and class information as its weights to improve the classification accuracy. We present the FPA algorithm and verify its performance. We compare its classification accuracy, storage requirement and actual classification time with k-NN and the EACH system on 7 carefully chosen data sets from the UCI Machine Learning Database repository.

articleTitle: Design of masterarm based on human kinematics and its integration to humanoid robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper a new masterarm based on human kinematics is proposed. Its controller structure, which consists of two controller parts, host and satellite, enables it to get a faster data update. The forward kinematics solution is derived for simplicity of hardware. To examine performance of this masterarm, it is implemented on the humanoid robot Centaur 2. This shows that this masterarm can be used for the tele-operation with a slave robot as well as the motion planner for any industrial robot.

articleTitle: Sensor modeling for achieving the tracking control of a pendulum
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Sufficiently accurate modeling and understanding of the sensors and actuators is necessary to arrive at numerically efficient state estimation and control algorithms since the measurement and sensors provided are corrupted to some degree by the presence of noise, biases and device inaccuracies. This paper describes the sensor and actuator modeling issues that were encountered while trying to achieve the trajectory tracking control of a simple pendulum.

articleTitle: Generalized adaptive edge-preserving image restoration algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Discontinuities present serious difficulties to standard regularization, since standard regularization theory imposes global smoothness constraints on possible solution. We propose a noise-adaptive edge-preserving image restoration algorithm based on the Markov random field image model. Our potential function is controlled by the weighting function for providing the capability of adaptively introducing the discontinuities into the solution. Moreover a new parameter is adopted to prevent the undesirable amplification of strong noise. Extending our previous work, we propose a nonlinear formulation of the regularization functional and derive an iterative algorithm for ensuring the global minimum. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Design and RF characteristics of traveling-wave electrodes for high-speed lithium niobate optical modulators
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Various types of traveling-wave electrodes for a high-speed LiNbO/sub 3/ optical intensity modulator were fabricated and characterized from the viewpoints of the characteristic impedance, the effective refractive index and an attenuation constant, which were extracted from measurements in the time domain and the frequency domain. The effects of trenching the SiO/sub 2/ buffer layer on electrical properties were examined. In this work the maximum value of the optical 3 dB modulation bandwidth, calculated by experimental results, was 18 GHz, and it is suggested that optical/RF phase velocity matching and the impedance matching can be achieved, and thus a higher value of the optical 3 dB modulation bandwidth can be obtained.

articleTitle: Signal processing via digital dynamic systems in parametric instability mode
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper discusses a digital signal processing based on the nonlinear dynamic systems in parametric oscillation mode. A recursive IIR digital filter with periodically varying parameters is used as a model of the dynamic system. Some applications of the filter in parametric generation mode are considered.

articleTitle: A wavelet-based approach to detect bladder tumor in color images
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: A wavelet-based method is proposed to extract the tumor region from a color medical image. The diagnosis of tumors is usually treated by inspecting the color of a tissue section stained by methylene blue. Traditional treatment of this process relied primarily on manual operation, erroneous assessment may thus arise from subjective judgement and eye measurement. Instead of a manual process, we propose a radial search technique, which will improve the accuracy by extracting the border of the tumor. Experimental results show that the proposed method is fast and can extract the tumor region successfully. Moreover, the technology developed in of this research will be helpful in the development of a computer-aided image analysis system to provide an automatic visual feature extraction tool for tumor diagnosis.

articleTitle: A modified two-step SOVA-based turbo decoder for low power and high performance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper two methods for low power and high performance are proposed for the soft output Viterbi algorithm (SOVA). One is to employ a modified architecture using a combination of a trace back (TB) for finding survivor states and a double trace back for finding the weight in two-step SOVA. The other is to lower the reliability values to the same level as a scaling factor to compensate for the distortion brought by overestimating those values in the original SOVA. We introduce a fixed scaling factor 0.25 or 0.33 for a rate 1/3 and 8-state turbo decoder with a 256-bit frame in hardware implementation to lower the reliability values. The modified architecture used in two-step SOYA allows important savings in area and power dissipation, compared with those of one-step (register exchange (RE) or TB) SOVA, and it also provides higher SNR performance (2 dB at the BER IE-04) than that of the conventional SOVA. Good performance is obtained by using a fixed scaling factor by which the soft output of SOVA can be considered as being multiplied. The simulation results show that the modified architecture with both methods contributes to low power and high performance.

articleTitle: Spatial speech coding for multi-teleconferencing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper describes a structural model for the implementation of multichannel speech coding for teleconferencing with spatial audio reproduction. Multiple nonaural speech sources are synthesized into binaural sound to produce a more realistic videoconferencing environment. The activity information of the individual binaural speech, which is determined by the voice activity detection algorithm, is used to calculate two weighting factors prior to mixing. Furthermore, a third level of weight adjustment can be carried out by adjusting these weighting factors before applying to the individual voice source. A scheme to remove undesirable noise spikes is also introduced. Both channels are then coded using the G.723.1 speech codec individually.

articleTitle: A new cloud detection algorithm for NOAA AVHRR imagery
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: For environmental monitoring of Earth's surface, one of the major problems is a detection of cloud-contaminated pixels. This paper describes a new automatic cloud detection algorithm. The method combines a threshold method using a local area parameter and clustering procedure. It has been successfully tested using AVHRR data of the Far East region which contains a mixture of land and ocean. Also, N-Land database results obtained with this scheme compared favorably with those obtained with the Saunders and Kriebel (1988) algorithm, which is one of the standard cloud detection procedures.

articleTitle: A pacemaker sensing algorithm for low amplitude p-wave detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: A pacemaker sensing algorithm is devised for p-wave detection in low SNR atrial electrograms. The algorithm uses three parameters, amplitude, slew rate, and p-p interval, and a fuzzy neural network structure is adopted to combine their characteristics. The signal characteristic of the current event is compared to those of three most recent p-waves, and the similarity and dissimilarity between them are used to determine if the event is a p-wave. In addition, the distributions of the characteristics of recent p-waves are considered such that a wider distribution takes a less synaptic weight.

articleTitle: An adaptive search algorithm for finding motion vectors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: It is known that the motions in real world video sequences are irregular. So it may be suitable for a search algorithm to find motion vectors for a certain sequence, but the algorithm may not be suitable for other sequences. Therefore, it seems to be a better idea to find out the characteristics of each block and to apply a proper search algorithm to find motion vectors for the real world video sequences. In this paper we propose an adaptive search algorithm (ASA). In ASA we deploy three block matching algorithms (BMAs) for finding motion vectors. Two causal neighboring blocks with respect to the current block are chosen to calculate the difference between the motion vectors of the two blocks for finding a motion vector of the current block. Then ASA chooses an appropriate algorithm out of the three BMAs by analysing the difference. Simulation results show that, compared to previous techniques, ASA is much more robust on most of the sequences, produces better performance in terms of motion compensation errors, and also reduces the computational requirements for finding motion vectors.

articleTitle: Quick torque controlled DC motor drive using BRM technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper presents a methodology for the technique of controlling a DC motor drive by implementation of quadrant operating mode which can ensure the torque control and speed with response time less than 2 seconds at all loading conditions. By implementation of binary rate modulation (BRM) technique, energy is fed with definite values of BRM 256 bits, with different patterns of high accuracy, and fixing scan time at 1.334 ms, the ripple is less than 2%, thus high efficiency can be achieved, from the consequence of the accuracy of energy feeding at low current. The stability of the whole system can be determined from circle criterion by root locus method. The instant reverse direction of rotation can be done by decreasing the energy to the lowest level while motor is running with no load at the speed of 100 rpm.

articleTitle: Third order polynomial black printer algorithm with ink jet printer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: A BPA (black printer algorithm) is the algorithm that controls a K (black ink) with respect to the CMY (cyan, magenta, yellow). We implement the third order polynomial BPA with an ink jet printer. First of all, it needs to find out the characteristics of the ink on the printer and then some equations describe the characteristics of the printer. The equations have third order polynomial forms using interpolation. An experiment and its results are provided. The BPA extends the gamut of the printer and raises the contrast as well as saving the amount of ink.

articleTitle: Physiological and psychological assessment of the hyper arousal utilizing a card sorting task
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In order to assess psychophysiological state of the hyper arousal, pulse transit time during a mental task was analyzed using the ECG R-wave finger plethysmogram onset asynchrony (RPA) measurement. As the mental task, the authors used the Wisconsin card sorting test (WCST). In the test, the following two kinds of condition were used: (1) a toy balloon burst setting with time limit, and (2) a narrated Japanese novel comprehension test. Under experimental conditions, measured RPAs were shorter than these in control conditions. It is suggested that the RPA is a possible tool for the assessment of hyper arousal through the autonomic responses.

articleTitle: A quantitative approach to the design of block data transfer mechanism for an SMP-based message-passing system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: The authors present the performance simulation and design of block data transfer mechanism for the SMP based message passing system called SPAX (Scalable Parallel Architecture computer based on X-bar network). For node-to-node block data transfer in SPAX, two schemes of memory-mapped transfer and DMA based transfer can be considered as a design alternative of network interface architecture. According to the simulation results, the DMA based scheme is more efficient for both latency and bandwidth rather than the memory mapped scheme in transferring the block data in SPAX. We also present the design of the block data transfer mechanism based on the DMA based transfer in detail, which is applied to SPAX.

articleTitle: A study on constructing the multiple-valued logic switching functions using the IATP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper presents a method of constructing the Multiple-Valued Logic Switching Functions (MVLSF) using the Improved Automatic Theorem Proving (IATP) techniques. The proposed method is as follows. First of all, we discuss the concepts of the automatic theorem proving (ATP) techniques including the syntactic and semantic property. We discuss several definitions of the IATP, that is the table pseudo functions Tab and Equal. Next, we propose the T-gate as a Building Block (BB) and describe the mathematical representation for the notation of T-gate. Then we discuss the important properties for the T-gate. Also, we propose several relationships: identity, constant, tautology and mod R cyclic relationship. Then we propose mod R negation relationship and the manipulation of don't care conditions. Finally, we propose the algorithm for constructing the method of multiple-valued logic switching functions.

articleTitle: Characteristics of optical fiber WDM with high isolation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: A high isolation optical fiber WDM (wavelength division multiplexer) with isolation better than 40 dB was obtained by cascading fused biconic tapered (FBT) optical fiber. The fabricated multiplexer was compared with WDMs produced by a dielectric thin film interference method. The values of isolation and bandwidth for the cascading FBT were calculated analytically. In practice, a coiling method was employed to reduce the number of WDM components. The optical fiber WDM was optimized by calculating the insertion loss and isolation according to the diameter and wind number of the coil. The fabricated optical fiber WDM showed a 40.5 and 41.2 dB of isolation and 0.7 and 0.6 dB of insertion loss for 1310 nm and 1550 nm, respectively.

articleTitle: Classification of Mandarin consonants based on wavelet transforms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper describes a new approach to classify the Mandarin consonants. Based on the wavelet transforms, the proposed method could divide the Mandarin consonants into five classes by using the product function. The product function is generated from the appropriate wavelet and scaling coefficients of input speech signal, and the classification criterion is dependent on the product function and its energy profile as well as zero-crossing rate (ZCR). In general, the duration, ZCR, and energy ratio of different consonant-vowel transitions have different representations. Hence, with the additional verification of energy profile and ZCR, the Mandarin consonants can be accurately classified into five types. An overall accuracy rate of 90.2% for first selection is achieved.

articleTitle: Improved multiplication free adaptive digital filter for the ISI reduction for data transmission
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: An improved multiplication free adaptive digital filter (IMADF) algorithm is proposed to reduce intersymbol interference (ISI) occurring in the data transmission channel. This algorithm is useful when the correlation of the input signal is high and compared with the multiplication adaptive digital filter (MADF) with its characteristics through convergence analysis. We implement a fractionally spaced equalizer (FSE) using this algorithm.

articleTitle: A colour object search technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: A colour object search technique is presented. Given an image, regions of probabilistic occurrence are generated (for each object model) by isolating regions whose colours are similar to the template colours. Since the template may exist at one or more of these region locations, each is examined individually. At each region location the object size is estimated and an expansion process initiated to include all pixels matching the template colours. Expansion is terminated when a match measure quantified by defining a term 'extent of match' (EOM), based on object size and the number of pixels with each model colour, is maximised. If the EOM exceeds a predefined threshold then the object is assumed to be present. Several experiments are presented which demonstrate the algorithm's robustness to scale, affine object distortion, varying illumination, image clutter and occlusion.

articleTitle: A multimedia based power system learning suite
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Power systems can be viewed as interconnections of electrical devices, performing basic functions like generation, transmission, distribution and utilization of electric energy. In the paper, it introduces various platforms for developing self-learning programs tailor made for fresh engineering students to the power system course for understanding various aspects of design, construction and operation of the power system in an interactive multi-media environment. The author shares his experience on developing an interactive multi-media system by using authoring and animating languages. By means of the multimedia tools, scripting commands can be generated to manipulate the sound, movies, and Internet functions including the mutual interactive communication channel.

articleTitle: Dual-mode low-power bus encoding for high-performance bus drivers
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: System-level buses consume much more power by orders of magnitude than on-chip buses. Existing bus encoding schemes are based on rail-to-rail CMOS bus drivers while recent high-performance devices include BiCMOS bus drivers to achieve transfer bandwidth required. BiCMOS drivers consume significant quiescent power as well as active power proportional to the bus frequency. This paper introduces a precise power consumption model for BiCMOS drivers with source-termination resistors. Dual-mode bus encoding scheme is suggested as well for variable bus frequencies for power management.

articleTitle: Implementation of MELP vocoder using lifting wavelet transform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper describes an implementation of MELP (mixed excitation linear prediction) vocoder. Subband division required for implementing the MELP vocoder was performed by the lifting wavelet transform. A new method to generate an appropriate glottal waveform was devised. In addition, three kinds of fluctuations observed in the steady parts of voiced speech were incorporated to enhance the naturalness of synthesized speech.

articleTitle: Design of fuzzy logic supplementary controller for STATCOM using polar coordinate variables
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Increasing interest has been seen in applying fuzzy set theory to controller design in power systems problems. In this paper, the design of fuzzy logic controller for STATCOM (static synchronous compensator) is based on the polar information obtained from the tie-line power flow. Time simulations are conducted on a four-generator interconnected power system. Computer results show the capability of the proposed fuzzy logic STATCOM in enhancing the dynamic behavior of an interconnected power system.

articleTitle: A study on logic design and architecture simulator design of a new on-chip multiprocessor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: We propose a novel on-chip multiprocessor architecture and a program-driven simulator for the processor. Today's superscalar processors already have very complicated control logics to resolve dependencies while increasing the instructions per-cycle (IPC). With the advent of semiconductor technology, integrating multiple processors into a chip is a promising alternative for increasing IPC. The new architecture simulator provides a coarse grain multithreaded architecture simulation environment. It runs various multithreaded benchmark programs. We can find out how various architecture-dependent parameters affect the behavior and performance of the on-chip multiprocessor as it includes not only the instruction set architecture but also the microarchitecture.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of Purkinje-Sanson images for the biofeedback therapy of myopia
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In order to treat pseudo-myopia, the authors have proposed a biofeedback therapy system with real time feedback of a patient's eye-lens thickness using Purkinje-Sanson (PS) images. The PS images are recorded with an infrared video-camera during lightening by visible LED light. After the images are digitized by a personal computer, the PS parameters (distances between the images or the area of the images) are calculated in order to estimate the lens thickness. The measured data show good coincidence with the anatomical data of extracted pigs eyes. Several clinical measurements on normal and nearsighted subjects show good correlations with r=0.958 between the real distances from the objects and the PS parameters. Computer simulations based on the optical model of the PS images are executed too, which show relative good coincidence with the real object's distances.

articleTitle: An architecture of decision feedback differential phase detection of M-ary DPSK signals
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: An architecture of decision feedback differential phase detection (DF-DPD) of M-ary DPSK signals is proposed. Conventional differential detection of M-ary DPSK signals uses the phase difference between a current symbol and the previous symbol. This method can make the receiver architecture simple. But it has poorer BER performance than coherent detection because it uses the previous noisy signal as the phase reference. To improve the BER performance of conventional differential detection, multiple symbol differential detection methods, such as maximum likelihood differential detection (ML-DD), Viterbi-DD, decision feedback differential detection (DF-DD), and DF-DPD, using L-1 past detected symbols, have been proposed. As L increases, the BER performance of DF-DPD improves but the complexity of the architecture increases dramatically. Thus, this paper proposes the simplified DF-DPD architecture, replacing the conventional delay and addition architecture with one accumulator. The proposed architecture also has a good BER performance with minimizing the phase error of the current received symbol using the accumulated phase differences of all DPD. The simulation results show that the BER performance of the proposed architecture approaches that of coherent detection.

articleTitle: Verification and development of network technology on Okinawa regional Internet eXchange (OIX)
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper gives an outline of the project of Okinawa regional Internet eXchange (OIX) which started in Okinawa, Japan and all kinds of related research and development subjects that have been studied in OIX. Owing both to its geographical factor and political factor, Okinawa is a unique prefecture in Japan. The Japanese government therefore is carrying out a policy different from other prefectures. In recent years, "The Multi-media Island Plan" was set forth by the Okinawa government as part of its policy, as well as the necessity of regional Internet infrastructure available for high speed communication. Under these circumstances, OIX, one of the model cases of regional Internet infrastructure, has drawn considerable attention. Depending on its future development, OIX is expected to become an official regional Internet infrastructure.

articleTitle: An efficient automatic testing algorithm for power supplies in electronic systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Since power supplies of electronic systems are important parts to operate without stopping, they are checked periodically and replaced when accidental failures are expected. Moreover it is required, in critical applications, to predict when the power supply will fail. Automatic testing equipment (ATE) described in this paper implements algorithms for testing various power supplies. This algorithm is based on the classification of characteristics and testing items of power supplies which have an AC input and DC outputs.

articleTitle: Interference suppression in SSB system based on the general programmable multi-system communication platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of interference suppression for single side band (SSB) system based on the general programmable multi-system communication platform. In the case of Gaussian noise amplitude modulation interference, the single-channel interference suppression algorithm is presented to process the deteriorated speech signal. The processing results of the real deteriorated speech signal show that the improvement of speech quality is obvious.

articleTitle: Filter evaluation in image deblocking by wavelet thresholding
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Blockiness occurs when using compression techniques based a block discrete cosine transform (BDCT) at high compression ratios. An approach for reducing the blockiness is based on wavelet thresholding. We evaluate various types of wavelet filters for use in this deblocking technique. The evaluation criteria used include the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), edge variance (EV) and visual performance. The results show that, among the wavelets studied, the Coiflet-5 filters give best performance for the deblocking purpose.

articleTitle: An adaptive array beamforming technique using cyclostationarity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In mobile communication systems, in order to extract the desired signal while suppressing the interference and noise, array beamforming techniques are usually employed. We propose a blind adaptive beamformer against co-channel interference and noise. The proposed method utilizes the cyclostationary properties of the communication signal, and a simple and efficient computational load. We performed computer simulations to compare the performance between the proposed method and the conventional method.

articleTitle: Creating an effective application by using multimedia and the Internet
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: It is apparent that the development of modern advanced computer technologies combining computation and communication will provide new exciting environments for many fields. We are concerned with using multimedia and the Internet to create new applications. At first, we view multimedia technologies as an effective way of visualizing abstract concepts that are generally hard to grasp. In addition, we observe Internet technologies as a powerful delivery method for information and knowledge. We choose the field of education as a test field to show our research results because the education field has immense potential for improvement through the use of computer technologies. As part of our research, we create several different educational modules, which are embedded in the World Wide Web. The topics for these modules cover many different subjects from mathematics to computer science.

articleTitle: A 300 MHz burst-pipelined CMOS SRAM macro with folded bit-line scheme
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper describes a new architecture and schemes for high speed SRAM. It is summarized as follows: (1) a folded bit-line architecture (FBLA) to reduce the delay time of bit-line by decreasing the parasitic capacitance, to reduce the area; (2) a double word-line activation (DWLA) technique to increase the data-rate twice and minimize row path delay, and (3) a high speed sensing scheme to decrease the delay time of sense amplifier. To verify these, a 8 Kb SRAM was designed using 0.6 /spl mu/m technology; it realized a 600 Mbyte/s (300 M/spl times/8/spl times/2) data-rate and the die size is 2.8 mm/spl times/0. 85 mm.

articleTitle: The operation test of 1 MW battery energy storage system in Korea
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper presents the development of 1 MW battery energy storage system (BESS) test facility and real operation. This system consists of lead acid batteries, an AC/DC power conversion system and a monitoring control system. The main items of the operation test are; basic performance test for load leveling and operation test. The operation test is carried our for interconnection performance. The system is connected to the utility system and tested to establish the system technology for load leveling and BESS operation algorithm considering time of use rate and a subsidy for power factor correction.

articleTitle: Dynamical language prediction for Korean language disorders in restricted domain
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: We developed an augmentative communication system that generates a well-formed sentence in Korean language by symbols for people with communication disorders. The system should place a minimal burden on the users. The augmentative communication aids combine the benefits of pre-stored messages with linguistic prediction capabilities to create unique acceleration techniques. Different from traditional approaches, the lexicon is organized along dimensions using a dynamic approach as a connectionist model. When the users press symbols, the software predicts verbs, which are displayed in scanning modes based on semantic markers. In order to generate the well-formed sentences, adequate postpositions follow it according to verbs for each input word.

articleTitle: A memory based classifier using the recursive partition averaging
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Proposes the RPA (Recursive Partition Averaging) algorithm in order to improve the storage requirements and classification time of the memory-based reasoning method. The proposed method enables us to use the storage more efficiently by extracting representatives from training patterns. After partitioning the pattern space recursively, it averages patterns in each hyper-rectangle to extract a representative. Also, we have used the mutual information between the features and classes as weights for the features, in order to improve the classification performance. Experimental results show that RPA is superior to K-NN (K-nearest neighbors) and the EACH system in terms of memory usage and classification accuracy.

articleTitle: A frequency splitting cable telephone system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this proposal, we use one great idea to realize the cable phone system using the digital addressing approach rather than conventional public switching network. With frequency splitting technology, the pseudo switch can be used as a switching device. The telephone's inter-handshake only uses one cable-line to tire together in parallel without any extra device such as the public switching circuits. The voice signal is controlled by through set-bottom-box, and allocated frequency slot. When we reserve CATV programs, there are over 100 k phone-gates using this cable system, this is enough for local communication. Further, if we can design a floating frequency slot rather than a fixed one, the useful number can be largely increased, where the useful telephone gate-number can be up to 10 M at least.

articleTitle: Performability modeling of channel allocation in cellular networks using stochastic reward nets
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: A combined performance and reliability/availability model for channel allocation is introduced. Stochastic reward nets (SRNs) models are presented for this purpose as Markov reward models, which are obtained by associating reward rates with Markov chain's state. To solve both non-exponential and state largeness problems, advanced modeling techniques such as phase approximation approach, hierarchical modeling and fixed point iteration techniques are described.

articleTitle: Tree-based reliable dissemination protocol with differential control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper presents the tree-based reliable dissemination (TRDP) with differential control services, a new scheme intended for satisfying efficient one-to-many delivery, with support for error control, flow control and congestion control. We describe the benefit of TRDP, and how TRDP works.

articleTitle: A simple instantaneous power theory and compensation performance evaluation for active power filters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: The fictitious power theory in time domain is very easy to understand, but the power-analyzing speed of active power filters is increased because of correlation algorithm. Also, conventional 3-D current coordinates for evaluating the performance of active power filters cannot evaluate the characteristics of nonlinear load currents, whether they are inductive or capacitive. Therefore, to solve such problems, this paper deals with the simple instantaneous power theory and the modified 3-D current coordinates for evaluating the compensation performance of active power filters. To confirm the validity, active power filters simulator is developed using C-language. From the simulation, results are discussed their utility.

articleTitle: Neural concurrent subsampling and interpolation for images
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for image subsampling and interpolation based on the feedforward neural network (FNN). The proposed technique employs a single FNN with three hidden layers for both subsampling and interpolation, providing the advantages of high speed, parallel processing capability, and good image reproduction quality. Experimental results show that the proposed technique exhibits an increased performance over conventional ones.

articleTitle: A filtering method for k-nearest neighbor query processing in multimedia data retrieval applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Efficient query processing in multi-dimensional indexing structures is an important issue for effective employment of multimedia data applications. A considerable number of studies, to date, have been conducted in this area. However the efficiency of the proposed solutions generally deteriorates as the dimension of the data increases. We introduce a filtering method for efficient processing of k-nearest neighbor queries in multi-dimensional indexing structures. The proposed method is based on the R*-tree, and uses a vantage point for effective similarity searches. Through the use of a vantage point we are abler to filter out data objects and decrease the distance computation time. Experimental results show that the k-nearest neighbor search that uses the proposed method consistently outperforms the search performance that uses the existing method for the R*-tree.

articleTitle: Methods of colour gamut extension algorithm development using experimental data
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Colour gamut is the colour area that a colour device can produce maximally. The process of maintaining the overall colour appearance of an image while extending the colours of the source device to fit the gamut of the target device is called gamut extension. As a number of colour devices have been used widely, the gamut extension technique is required across colour media. In this study, existing gamut extension methods were surveyed and gamut extension methods using observer experimental data are suggested.

articleTitle: An dynamic Hangul E-mail address management protocol
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: The conventional E-mail address system is represented by a domain name and user name on a host, which consists of English characters. So it is impossible to use Korean E-mail address because the word ordering of the existing English domain is different from the Korean domain. Therefore the necessity of a Korean domain name management system, which provides the operation and management incorporating existing the DNS (domain name system) and is familiar with Korean, is increasing. In this paper the HEMMP (Hangul E-mail address management protocol) is proposed, which supports the Korean mail address system and enables the collection and provision of user information on the network management unit. The Dynatron (dynamic traverse on user information service) is also implemented, which is the dynamic user information searching system using the HEMMP.

articleTitle: An efficient algorithm for network reconfiguration in distribution system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient algorithm for loss reduction of distribution system by sectionalizing switch operation in the distribution system. Simulated annealing can avoid escape from local minima by accepting improvements in cost, but the use of this algorithm is also responsible for an excessive computation time requirement. To overcome this major limitation of simulated annealing, we may use modified simulated annealing. The polynomial-time cooling schedule is used which is based on the statistics calculation during the search. This approach results in saving CPU time. Numerical examples demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Multicast knockout ATM switch with batcher network for multiple priority classes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: We propose the multicast knockout ATM switch with batcher network in order to satisfy the different requirements of the cell loss probability for multiple priority classes. The proposed model sorts the cells according to the identification number of a priority class by a batcher network in order to handle multicast cells of multiple classes. We evaluate the cell loss probability by numerical calculations and computer simulations and show the mean waiting time by computer simulations. As a result, we find that our proposed model can handle the different requirements of the cell loss probability for multiple priority classes without increasing the mean waiting time of each priority class.

articleTitle: Multi-level encoding and placement techniques for multi-resolution video streams on a disk array
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: We propose multi-level encoding and placement techniques to efficiently support the retrieval of video streams on a disk array at different resolutions. For the MPEG-1 compression algorithm, this encoding technique first partitions the parent video stream in the temporal dimension. Each frame in the sub-stream is then partitioned in the chroma dimension yielding a low-resolution and a residual component. The server stores blocks of a component on a disk and stores blocks of different components on consecutive disks in a round-robin manner. The lower the resolution level being maintained, the smaller is the number of disks accessed by each client.

articleTitle: Design of an image communication system based on adaptive equalizer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an efficient multimedia (audio, image, etc.) communication system for reliable transmission of vulnerable compressed images over wireless radio channels. We study the removal of noise and ISI components by using the equalizer system. The proposed equalizers are designed based on the non-linear MMSE (minimum mean square error) algorithm using the Taylor series expansion. In simulation, we consider that equalizer-a is a nonlinear MMSE equalizer including an ISI canceller and equalizer-b is the same equalizer without the ISI canceller. Simulation results show that the performance of equalizer-a is improved under general Gaussian and dependent Gaussian noise environments in the positive SNR value; and proposed equalizer-b, in the dependent Gaussian noise, has a good performance in the negative SNR value as compared to other systems.

articleTitle: Automatic gain control of 16 QAM in microcell Rayleigh fading channel
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the time constant of an AGC (automatic gain control) loop filter which is very important in the micro cell environment and its duration should be around 12 /spl lambda/ of the carrier frequency. Furthermore, we introduce the performance measurement system of pilot symbol assisted 16 quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) system which use 3/4 trellis coded modulation with a sub-optimum Viterbi decoder. The sub-optimum Viterbi decoder required only 1/3 computation complexity of the conventional Viterbi decoder, with negligible performance degradation in the field test.

articleTitle: Design and realization of driving amplifier MMIC circuit stages for KT IMT-2000 handset
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper, an IMT-2000 driving amplifier MMIC with variable gain amplifier (VGA) to linearly controlled output gain is designed, fabricated and analyzed. The driving amplifier (which is composed of three stages, the middle stage gain is 40 dB which is provided by cascaded junction of the three stages) is realized. We have designed a stable and reliable output stage driving amplifier for the KT IMT-2000 handset, and realized the following improved features: 3.5 times bandwidth, 15 dBm output power, 25/spl sim/27 dB output power gain, -15/spl sim/-20 dB VSWR, 3 dB gain flatness at the operating frequency.

articleTitle: Design of mobile communication systems using spatial data
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper describes the design of a cellular mobile communication system on the two-dimensional plane using spatial data. This paper considers spatial data indicating vehicles' flow characteristics on the road network. This paper discusses how to determine the number of channels in each cell considering the spatial data.

articleTitle: Optimal rate based flow control for ABR services in ATM networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper, we present an explicit rate-based flow control scheme for ABR services, which is based on the linear quadratic Gaussian (LQG) control-theoretic approach. The goal of our scheme is to share the available bandwidth capacity fairly among many sources while maintaining the queue length at a bottleneck node at a desired level.

articleTitle: Face recognition using wavelets and fuzzy C-means clustering
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper we perform wavelet transform of the input 256/spl times/256 color image and decompose input image into low-pass and high-pass components. After finding the position of face using the histogram of the edges, a face region in low-pass band image is extracted. Since RGB color image is easily affected by illumination, the image of low pass component is normalized, and a face region is detected using face color information. In this paper, we use 3000 images of 10 persons, and KL transform is applied in order to classify face vectors effectively. FCM (Fuzzy C-means) algorithm classifies face vectors, which have similar features, into the same cluster. In this case, the number of cluster is equal to that of a person, and the mean vector of each cluster is used as codebook. We estimate the proposed system's performance through experiments. The recognition rate of learning images and that of testing image are computed using correlation coefficients and Euclidean distance.

articleTitle: Delay fairness in demand priority networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: A demand priority network is a high speed local area network. Compared with a fast Ethernet, it is known to have advantages in transmission of delay-sensitive traffic. However, in a demand priority network, the packet delay time is unbounded and the delay levels experienced at stations are unfair. In this paper, we consider Round Robin and FCFS schemes for scheduling packet transmission. Under each scheme, we develop an analytical approximation method for mean delay calculation, and investigate the mean and standard deviation of the packet delay time by the approximation and simulation methods. By introducing a degree of delay fairness, the Round Robin and FCFS schemes are evaluated in delay fairness.

articleTitle: Glottal inverse filtering (GIF) using closed phase WRLS-VFF-VT algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the estimation of a glottal excitation source using the glottal inverse filtering (GIF) analysis method. The WRLS-VFF-VT algorithm, which sequentially estimates the filter coefficients, estimation error, the variable forgetting factor, the pitch period, and the instant at which the glottis closes, can be applied to GIF analysis. For the estimation of the pitch period and the glottal opening/closed instants, we can use the VFF signal. The performance of this method is compared with other methods such as the two-pass and two-channel methods.

articleTitle: FPGA implementation of subband image encoder using discrete wavelet transform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: The introduction of digital communication networks such as integrated services digital networks (ISDN) and digital storage media have rapidly developed. Due to a large amount of image data, compression is the key technique in still image and video using digital signal processing for transmission and storage. Digital image compression provides solutions for various image applications that represent digital image requiring a large amount of data. The proposed DWT (discrete wavelet transform) filter bank consists of a simple architecture, but it is efficiently designed that a user obtains a wanted compression rate as only the input parameter. If it is implemented by an FPGA chip, the designed encoder operates at 12 MHz.

articleTitle: A study on consonants/vowels phonetic segmentation of Korean isolated words based on a rule-based system for the phenomenon of Korean vocalization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: This paper investigates the Korean rule-based system and its speech segmentation application with phonetic value. The discrete wavelet transform is used as a part of a front-end processor by which the phonetic value shape extracts non-uniform blocks. In non-uniform blocks, the extracted feature parameter is derived by consonants/vowels phonetic value segmentation that is based on VQ/HMM. 10 speakers (male) evaluated the results on a portion of Korean isolated words TIMIT corpus consisting of ten each isolated Korean words. Ultimately, the proposed algorithm aims to reduce the number of frames per speech signal as much as possible without an appreciable reduction in the recognition rate of the system, and obtains a frame characterizing the signal of a consonant/vowels phonetic value on Korean vocalization.

articleTitle: The ARP cache structure of LAN emulation server in ATM-LAN system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Combing ATM technology with LAN is one of the methods to improve network performance and enhance network capability by providing QoS in the network service. The ATM Forum's LAN emulation efficiently combines the LAN service with ATM transport technology. The LE ARP (address resolution protocol) cache is maintained by the entities of LAN emulation. This paper looks into the LE ARP cache and its usage. This paper proposes a simple and efficient LE ARP cache structure and implementation method using both software and hardware methodology.

articleTitle: Caption segmentation method in videos using isodata clustering of topographical features
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Conventional caption extraction approaches often use a spatial variance method or a color reduction method such as color histogram and color quantization. These methods are time-consuming and restrict the colors for extracting captions. In this paper we propose a method that extracts caption areas using TFs (topographical features) and isodata color clustering. After extracting TFs points using the topographical characteristics of characters, the isodata clustering method is used to cluster the similar colors. The point-line-region method is used to construct the blocks for each of the clustered groups. Constructed blocks are verified and candidate areas are decided. Caption regions are determined by testing several conditions and verifying those candidate areas. Experimental results show that the candidate region extraction rate is 100%, and the character region extraction rate is 98%.

articleTitle: Implementation of a WWW interactive 3D graphics exploratorium
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Can students contribute in building a 3D graphics Web? The article describes the experience gained by participation of all the students in the undergraduate computer graphics subject taught at the Nanyang Technological University at Singapore. The Webware module called a Distributed Computer Graphics Exploratorium has been designed to give students an understanding of the fundamental principles and techniques used at the heart of modern graphics systems. Each section in the courseware corresponds to taught lecture plus tutorial work, lab work and self directed study.

articleTitle: Analysis of time-varying digital filter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: The paper reviews the study of linear time-varying (LTV) digital filters, systematizing different analytical approaches and comparing them with linear time-invariant (LTI) digital filters. Various problems in analysis, design and application of the LTV DF, and future work in this area of research are discussed.

articleTitle: A new fault-tolerant ATM switch architecture
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: Wang's (1997) modified MOBAS has a similar modular distributed structure to Chao's multicast output buffered ATM switch (MOBAS). The reduction of switch size and the fault tolerance are important issues in designing an ATM switch for reliable satellite communications. In this paper we propose a new ATM switch architecture by slightly changing Wang's modified MOBAS. The proposed switch has an easy fault reconfiguration scheme with graceful performance degradation like Chao's MOBAS and employs fewer switch elements than the MOBAS.

articleTitle: Resonance of a rectangular microstrip antenna on a uniaxial substrate with a superstrate loaded
publicationTitle: Proceedings of IEEE. IEEE Region 10 Conference. TENCON 99. 'Multimedia Technology for Asia-Pacific Information Infrastructure' (Cat. No.99CH37030)
abstract: In this paper the problem of a rectangular microstrip antenna printed on a uniaxial substrate with a superstrate loaded is treated. The effects of superstrate on the complex resonant frequency of the rectangular microstrip antenna on a uniaxial substrate is studied. Special constitutive relations are used in describing the uniaxial properties of the matrial, such as the dyadic Green's function can be formulated. Electromagnetic fields and boundary conditions in the spectral region were used in finding Green's function.
